ModMetaData.name: TouchDeck Bridge
ModMetaData.author: Marcel171297
ModMetaData.description:
Connects RimWorld to TouchDeck (phone or tablet as a control panel).
The mod opens a small local TCP server (default 127.0.0.1:34200). The TouchDeck plugin "rimworld" connects to it, shows date, speed, mood, silver, research and more live on your buttons and sends commands: pause, speed, save, screenshot, draft all, jump to colonists or the last letter, show a message, open main tabs, choose research. Events (letters, raids, deaths, mental breaks, finished research) trigger TouchDeck events.
Settings: Mod settings › TouchDeck Bridge (on/off, address, port, secret, send interval). Remote access (address other than 127.0.0.1) needs a secret of at least 12 characters. Unencrypted: only use it in your own network, never on the open internet.
Verbindet RimWorld mit TouchDeck (Handy oder Tablet als Bedienfeld): Werte live auf den Buttons, Befehle per Fingertipp, Ereignisse als TouchDeck-Auslöser.
